name: CRM Software Adoption
description: Size the market for CRM software adoption among small businesses.
formula: SAM = Population x Penetration Rate x Purchase Frequency x Average Spend x Serviceable %
solution_logic: Step 1: Identify addressable population = target_population x addressable_segment
Step 2: Apply penetration rate = addressable_population x penetration_rate
Step 3: Calculate annual spend per user = purchase_frequency x avg_spend_per_purchase
Step 4: Calculate TAM = penetrating_users x annual_spend_per_user
Step 5: Calculate SAM = TAM x serviceable_pct
key_insight: This is a seat/subscription market, not a population market -- the population is small businesses, and the real constraint is how many are reachable by this specific go-to-market motion, not how many exist nationally.
common_mistakes: Sizing all small businesses instead of the subset without a CRM today (the real greenfield)
Forgetting to annualize monthly subscription spend (x12) for an inherently recurring purchase
Ignoring serviceable %, which caps the market at what this company's specific channel can actually reach
framework_soundbite: Small businesses without a CRM, reachable by this go-to-market, paying monthly -- three filters before you multiply.
business_contexts: a CRM software startup targeting small businesses
a PE-backed software roll-up evaluating a CRM acquisition
question_patterns: A CRM startup targeting small businesses wants to size the serviceable addressable market it can actually reach before its next fundraising round.

serviceable_pct.unit: % reachable by the startup's go-to-market motion

prompts.advanced: A software roll-up backed by a growth equity firm is evaluating a small CRM vendor whose founder claims a market size the firm's own analysts think is inflated by an unrealistic reach assumption. Build an independent serviceable-addressable-market estimate before the term sheet is finalized.
prompts.beginner: Estimate the serviceable addressable market for CRM software subscriptions the startup's current go-to-market motion can reach.
prompts.intermediate: A CRM startup targeting small businesses wants to size the serviceable addressable market it can actually reach before its next fundraising round.

approach_guidance.top_down_why: Start from small businesses, narrow to those without a CRM today, apply this startup's penetration and reachable %, then multiply by monthly spend -- narrowing down from the total small-business count.
approach_guidance.bottom_up_why: Or start from one subscribing customer: their annual spend (12 x $/month), then scale up by how many reachable, CRM-less businesses this go-to-market motion can win. The more natural default for a subscription business -- most SaaS pitches build up from ARPU, not down from a population.
